description: This file defines the 'BuzzPostAPI' class in the 'OrangeHRM\Buzz\Api' namespace. It implements REST API endpoints for creating, retrieving, and updating 'buzz' posts within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, including support for posts with text, photos, and videos. It contains methods for validation, transaction management, and handling different post types, along with OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: BuzzPostAPI
classes.description: REST API class for managing 'buzz' posts in OrangeHRM, including creation, fetching, and updating posts with support for different media types, utilizing roles, validation, and transaction management.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception as listing all posts is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception as validation for getAll is not supported.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new buzz post, including text, photos, or video link, saving associated entities, and returning the created post.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new post, validating type, text, photos, or video link depending on the post type.

methods.name: setBuzzPost
methods.description: Internal method to set common post properties including text and employee info.

methods.name: setBuzzShare
methods.description: Links a BuzzShare entity to a post and associates the employee and type.

methods.name: setBuzzPhotos
methods.description: Processes an array of base64-encoded photos to create BuzzPhoto entities linked to a post.

methods.name: setBuzzVideoPost
methods.description: Creates and associates a BuzzLink entity for video posts with embedded URLs.

methods.name: getPhotoValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for verifying photo attachments.

methods.name: getVideoValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for verifying video links.

methods.name: getTextValidationRuleForOtherPost
methods.description: Returns validation rule for optional post text, max length.

methods.name: getTextValidationRuleForTextPost
methods.description: Returns validation rule for required post text max length.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; delete operation not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; validation for delete not supported.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a single post by ID, optionally returning detailed model based on query parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation for the getOne method, including ID and optional model type.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing post, including validation, media modifications, and saving changes.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a post, including optional modifications.

methods.name: updateBuzzVideoPost
methods.description: Updates video URL link associated with a BuzzPost.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines which post model class to use based on query parameter.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Fetches detailed BuzzFeedPost data for a given post ID.
